notes.title: Hybrid mode, custom paints and a new circuit available now!
notes.notes: [p]The latest update, out now, introduces the “Hybrid Mode”, adding an extra layer of strategy to races, along with a “Paint Customization” feature that lets you personalize your car’s design.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Customize Your Car with the New Paint Feature![/b][/p][p]Personalize your car’s design as you like and hit the track, you can customize the body color, apply decals and brushes. Your customized car can also be used in online races! Show off your custom design![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271014/b54932fbcd98abffec39de1d095f10bec8548f4c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Accelerate the thrill of racing with the Hybrid Mode![/b][/p][p]By turning ON the new “Hybrid Mode”, you can activate the “Hybrid Booster” at any time during a race.[/p][p]Using it temporarily boosts your speed, giving you an edge to win.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271014/92e6db163cc5f1b9f3e7284c22d02ada6957d7b8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Course: “Alberta SuperSpeedway”[/b][/p][p]A new Canadian circuit featuring high banked corners and heavy elevation changes on it's alternative[/p][p]layout. Success depends on how smoothly you can navigate the consecutive corners.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45271014/c3c7ce821fdf761b56e53997cf98bc6b063d39c7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/p][p]Added support for 21:9 resolutions.[/p][p]Bugfixes.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Nov 29 Hotfix
notes.notes: Along with some minor fixes, the countdown in online modes was changed from 15 seconds to 45 seconds for better game experience.
